_README: CAPTURED, NOT WRITTEN. Regenerate with: cd backend && npm run capture:coldopen

original.request: Run a full marathon in 3 weeks, starting from zero running experience.

counter.statement: Go from never-run to a first 5K race in 12 weeks, running 4 days a week — then build toward the marathon from there.
counter.subtitle: The marathon is real — three weeks from zero isn't. Let's build the runner first.

risk.line: Zero running history means your legs adapt slower than your enthusiasm — that's the whole reason for the longer runway.
risk.detail: Tendons and joints take weeks to catch up to what your lungs will happily do. That gap is exactly what the 3-week version would have broken, and it's priced into the 84.
